# tape agent context

Tape is Axiom's self-hosted stand-in for Google Cloud Pub/Sub: a
Raft-replicated durable topic service with named subscriptions over its own
HTTP/1.1 + h2c API.

## Contract

- Route inventory: `tape spec --format routes`, or `GET /openapi.json` on a
  running node. The committed snapshot is `clients/openapi.json`.
- Schemas: `tape spec --format json-schema`.
- Typed clients: `tape spec gen --lang ts|py|rust --out <dir>`.
- Support per Pub/Sub surface: `STATUS.md`. Future outcomes: `ROADMAP.md`.

## Behaviour

- A topic is an append-only, offset-numbered journal; a subscription is a
  named cursor into one topic.
- Append is acknowledged after the durable write; pull returns a window from
  the subscription cursor; ack advances the cursor cumulatively.
- Per-message ack, competing subscribers, push, seek, ordering keys, filters,
  and schemas are ROADMAP outcomes, not shipped behaviour.

## Commands

- Build: `cargo build -p tape` (release: `cargo build --release -p tape`).
- Test: `cargo test -p tape`; feature targets: `cargo test -p tape --features operator,backup`.
- Serve: `tape serve --bind 127.0.0.1:7137 --store <path>`.
- Deploy renders: `tape k8s crd|operator|instance render`, `tape dockerfile render`.
- Backup: `tape backup --url <node> --dest <file://|s3://|gs://>`.

## Root artifacts

- `README.md`: product brief, workflow, capabilities, and gates.
- `STATUS.md`, `ROADMAP.md`: support matrix and outcomes.
- `docs/deployment-handoff.md`: serve flags, environment, probes, runbooks.
- `docs/product/`: promises, one `## <title>` section per capability area.
- `build.sh`, `install.sh`: local build and install entrypoints.
